title: GlobalProtect VPN Fails on macOS Sequoia
content: Symptom: Users on macOS Sequoia report GlobalProtect VPN gets stuck at 'Connecting...' or fails immediately. Cause: Apple changed the background extension policy in the new OS. Fix: Have the user open System Settings > Privacy & Security > scroll down to 'Security' and click 'Allow' for 'Palo Alto Networks'. Restart the Mac and reconnect.

title: Outlook Constant Password Prompts
content: Symptom: Outlook keeps prompting for a password even though the user can log into other services successfully. Fix: Do NOT reset the password again. The user has a stale credential saved. Open Windows Credential Manager -> Windows Credentials -> clear any entries related to 'MicrosoftOffice16' or 'Outlook'. Restart Outlook and enter the new password when prompted.

title: 4th Floor Printer Offline (HP LaserJet Pro)
content: Symptom: Users report the 4th floor HP LaserJet Pro is offline or out of toner. Fix: IT does not manage physical printer supplies for the 4th floor. This must be routed to the Facilities team via their portal. Do NOT dispatch an IT technician.

title: Salesforce Single Sign-On (SSO) Error 403
content: Symptom: User gets a 403 Forbidden error when trying to log into Salesforce via Okta SSO. Cause: The user's Active Directory account is missing the 'Sales_Team' security group. Fix: Add the user to the 'Sales_Team' AD group, wait 15 minutes for sync, and ask them to try again.
